text: Hercules explains the target with clear context and concrete verification.
The system plans the work by naming constraints actions and evidence.
The model plane records provenance before a native checkpoint becomes active.
The training pipeline checks held out evidence before claiming completion.
The compiler tests generated artifacts before the production release path.
The evidence layer uses deterministic hashes to identify model checkpoints.
A reliable plan states the goal the blockers the next action and verification.
A native checkpoint should pass evaluation before production activation.
The retrieval layer ranks relevant knowledge before research consumes it.
The Guard model classifies actions before execution.
The Agent model routes code research vision speech and general requests.
A byte tokenizer can represent text without unknown token failures.
Byte pair merges shorten repeated sequences learned from owned training text.
The language model predicts the next token from recent token history.
Perplexity measures language model surprise on held out token sequences.
Round trip decoding verifies that tokenization preserves the original text.
The first generative baseline is small and does not claim frontier reasoning.
Later neural checkpoints can reuse the same provenance and activation controls.
Pinned workflows and owner code policy keep runtime dependencies auditable.
Canonical main is the source of truth after checks pass.
